about.title: AI Engineering, data and product with a software foundation
paragraphs: I am Daniel García Nilo, a Computer Engineering graduate with a software engineering foundation and a growing specialization in AI Engineering and Data Science. From October 2024 to May 2026 I worked in the Architecture Department at Grupo Catalana Occident / Occident, contributing to corporate solutions where AI, data and processes had direct business impact.

At Occident I worked on the evolution of the corporate IATeach module, an AI-oriented solution for document management and internal processes. That experience gave me real context in architecture, integration with corporate systems, business logic with C#/.NET, SQL, GAAN interfaces, JavaScript validations, agile work with JIRA and collaboration in environments where quality and traceability matter.

My current focus is building applied AI systems: agents, RAG, APIs, automation, analytics and data products. I combine software engineering discipline with Data Science to turn information into decisions, prototypes into maintainable solutions and models into useful tools.
